scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to Defence Forces Personnel
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Applicant must be a Defence Forces Personnel (Army, Navy, or Air Force) who has become permanently disabled due to war, operational areas, terrorist activities, natural calamities, etc.
Applicant must have been discharged from Defence Forces service because of the disability
Disability must be a permanent percentage as determined by the Initial Medical Board
Application must be submitted within three years of the disability
benefits_summary: Ex-gratia grant ranging from ₹15 lakh to ₹35 lakh based on disability percentage
